---
applyTo: "**/*.cs,**/*.csproj"

# C# Coding Standards

When writing or reviewing C# files in `finos/morphir-dotnet`, follow [CODING_STANDARDS.md](../../CODING_STANDARDS.md) and [.agents/CSHARP_CODING_STANDARDS.md](../../.agents/CSHARP_CODING_STANDARDS.md).

If the C# code calls F# types or members, also follow [.agents/skills/fsharp-csharp-interop/SKILL.md](../../.agents/skills/fsharp-csharp-interop/SKILL.md) and run `fsharp-csharp-interop-reviewer` on the diff.
